description: Save one attachment as a new file in the attachment folder, ~/.fluxmail/attachments, instead of returning its content. Give the path relative to the folder. The file mustn't exist yet: Fluxmail never replaces one. No part of the path may start with a dot. The attachment size limit does not apply.

accountId.description: Account to operate on. Optional when exactly one account is connected.

attachmentId.description: Opaque attachment ID returned by message metadata

path.description: New file name, relative to the folder

name: save_attachment
title: Save attachment
